PO.Data: Source Document Column (lookup in Print Format table)
Only lookup columns (Table/TableDir/Search) or ID from print format table

AD_Column.AD_Reference_ID IN (15,16) AND AD_Column.ColumnName NOT IN ('Created','Updated') AND AD_Column.AD_Table_ID = (SELECT CASE WHEN dc.AD_Reference_ID IN (13,19) THEN (SELECT tt.AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table tt WHERE tt.TableName = SUBSTR(dc.ColumnName,1,LENGTH(dc.ColumnName)-3)) WHEN dc.AD_Reference_ID IN (18,30) AND COALESCE(dc.AD_Reference_Value_ID,0) > 0 THEN (SELECT rt.AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Ref_Table rt WHERE rt.AD_Reference_ID = dc.AD_Reference_Value_ID) ELSE (SELECT tt.AD_Table_ID FROM AD_Table tt WHERE tt.TableName = SUBSTR(dc.ColumnName,1,LENGTH(dc.ColumnName)-3)) END FROM AD_Column dc WHERE dc.AD_Column_ID = @SourceDocumentColumn_ID@)
